title: IIT Guwahati Student Drowns After Falling into Brahmaputra
summary: An IIT Guwahati student drowned after falling into the Brahmaputra River. The incident occurred on Tuesday, with preliminary information suggesting it was an accident. A search operation was launched, and another student was rescued. The police have confirmed that two students were swept away by strong currents in the river. The incident is under investigation.
summary_points: An IIT Guwahati student drowned after falling into the Brahmaputra River on Tuesday.
Preliminary information suggests the incident was an accident.
A search operation was launched, and another student was rescued.
The police have confirmed that two students were swept away by strong currents in the river.
title_hi: आईआईटी गुवाहाटी छात्र ब्रह्मपुत्र में डूब गए
summary_hi: आईआईटी गुवाहाटी छात्र ब्रह्मपुत्र में गिरने के बाद डूब गए। घटना मंगलवार को हुई, और प्रारंभिक जानकारी से यह पता चलता है कि यह दुर्घटना एक अनावश्यक घटना थी। एक खोज अभियान चलाया गया, और दूसरा छात्र बचाया गया। पुलिस ने पुष्टि की है कि दो छात्र तेज़ जलधाराओं से गुजरने से डूब गए। घटना में शामिल होने वाली जांच चल रही है।
